title: The Nation That Defied the Natural Order
intro: In a region whose story echoes through the ages, a community lived in open rebellion against the laws of purity. Their deeds were so unprecedented that they are remembered as a warning for all humanity. Who were these souls, and what fate overtook them?
clues: We dwelt in a land by a route that travelers often passed through, but we made their journey perilous.
We committed such acts of indecency that no one in the worlds had ever done before.
A messenger from among us called us to abandon our ways, but we rejected him and demanded the punishment if he was truthful.
When handsome guests came to our city, we sought to assault them, not knowing they were messengers of destruction.
We were warned of a terrible punishment if we did not desist, but we mocked the warning and remained in our sin.
A rain of stones from the sky fell upon us, and our homes were overturned, leaving not a trace except a sign for those who reflect.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Committed unprecedented immorality and obstructed roads
Cheated in trade and shortchanged the people
Built a lofty tower to challenge the heavens
trial.answer: Committed unprecedented immorality and obstructed roads

location.label: Key Element
options: A she-camel emerging from a rock
A staff transforming into a serpent
A boat constructed on a mountain
A fire that became cool and peaceful

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Destroyed by a rain of stones from the sky
outcome.answer: Destroyed by a rain of stones from the sky

arabic: إِنَّا مُنزِلُونَ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ رِجْزًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْسُقُونَ
verse: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient." (29:34)
